answer: Require each agent's operator to link a distinct verified bank account by confirming two random micro-deposits, and allow one agent per account. Banks already run identity checks, so clones cannot simply wander in on a zephyr of free sign-ups. A sybil farmer needs a separate real account for every fake agent; mule accounts sell for about $300 each, so a 200-agent farm costs roughly $60,000, and a raven-black cluster of fresh accounts is easy for banks to flag.
